aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:861.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Director of Partnership Sales works closely with the department Vice Presidents, SVP's, and entire AEG Global Partnerships structure/resources to generate and close sponsorship sales for assigned properties and/or regions. This position is responsible for seeing a sponsorship sale through completion which includes developing pitches, negotiating deal points, addressing client concerns, and finding creative solutions to partner assigned properties with brands. The Director of Sponsorship Sales will effectively manage their sales team to set sales goals and ensure monthly, quarterly, and annual goals are met by employing various sales techniques, creating and maintaining new business relationships, and setting expectations for their employees. Essential Functions Sell complex sponsorship assets that include media, experiential, and VIP hospitality packages to assigned event properties and locations. Identify and cultivates brands/marketing executives within targeted accounts who make event marketing and media decisions. Create and develops presentations for clients and potential clients. This includes developing creative concepts for pitches, utilizing various resources for execution. Occasionally management of a budget related to sales materials. Address clients’ concerns, questions and objections to close sponsorship deals. Resolve deal discrepancies, works with legal team to draft deal terms. Negotiate and re-negotiates sponsorship assets/deal points for renewal and long-standing sponsorship deals. Keep sales management apprised of progress toward established revenue goals and of the progress in closing identified prospects. Uses department CRM system. Required Qualifications BA/BS Degree (4-year) Related field 6-8 years Related work experience Expertise in identifying opportunities, developing strategies and negotiating creative solutions. Exemplary problem-solving, communication and presentation skills. Ability to synergize the efforts of individuals and teams from multiple AEG business units to accomplish the goals of the company. Ability to work with leadership to effectively manage a sales team by motivating and supporting them to reach their sales goals. Known throughout the industry for their poise and professionalism when interacting with internal and external contacts. Proficient with Microsoft Office Products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and ability to learn required business systems. Possess a strong sales acumen and knowledge of the music space. Proven track record in building successful partnerships as well as consistently securing investments with FORTUNE 500 organizations. Must have an established reputation and track record of success, gained with any combination of major brands or agencies Payscale: $140,000-$157,000 Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. jobgether-jobgether:lever:7588bb42-7728-.title: Enterprise Quality Statistician
jobgether-jobgether:lever:7588bb42-7728-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Enterprise Quality Statistician based in United States. This fully remote role offers the opportunity to apply advanced statistical expertise to healthcare quality, performance improvement, and population health initiatives. You will serve as a statistical subject-matter expert, transforming complex healthcare data into actionable insights. The position combines statistical modeling, epidemiology, program evaluation, and quality improvement methodologies. You will work closely with senior analytics leaders and business stakeholders to identify opportunities that can improve health outcomes. Your analyses will support quality measures, including HEDIS and STAR ratings, as well as strategic decision-making. This is an impactful role for an analytical professional who enjoys solving complex problems and communicating data-driven recommendations to diverse audiences. Serve as a statistical expert for quality and performance evaluations, study design, analytical methodologies, and program improvement initiatives. Partner with senior analytics leadership and business stakeholders to develop quality analysis plans, conduct assessments, and identify opportunities to improve health outcomes. Gather, integrate, and analyze internal and external healthcare, quality, and epidemiological data from multiple sources. Design and apply statistical models to predict HEDIS rates, STAR ratings, and other quality performance measures to support business decisions. Develop and conduct epidemiological studies, including case-control, cohort, and other study designs, to identify target populations and support intervention strategies. Apply descriptive, predictive, and statistical testing techniques to evaluate the impact of quality initiatives and performance improvement activities. Support quality and compliance reporting by collecting, interpreting, and presenting relevant data and findings. Research and evaluate relevant evidence and publications to inform population health and quality initiatives. Communicate analytical findings and projections to administrative and business leaders through clear, compelling visualizations, presentations, and written reports. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives using methodologies such as the Model for Improvement, Lean, and Six Sigma. Requirements: Master's degree in Statistics, Public Health, Biostatistics, Health Promotion, Evaluation, or a related field. At least 5 years of relevant experience in program evaluation, statistical analysis, or a closely related discipline. Demonstrated experience designing epidemiological studies and applying statistical methodologies to healthcare or population-level data. Strong hands-on experience with SAS and SQL . Knowledge of statistical modeling, hypothesis testing, descriptive statistics, and analytical techniques for solving complex problems. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, along with working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Access. Ability to interpret healthcare and managed care data; experience with healthcare data coding is a plus. Previous experience with HEDIS, healthcare quality management, managed care, or population health is strongly preferred. Knowledge of quality improvement frameworks such as Lean, Six Sigma, and the Model for Improvement is desirable. Strong epidemiological research, critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex statistical findings into clear business recommendations. Strong data visualization and presentation skills, with the ability to create clear and compelling graphics for varied audiences. No specific professional license or certification is required. Benefits: Annual salary range: $72,200–$115,500, with compensation determined based on education, training, experience, role comp

jobgether-jobgether:lever:fd60e125-793e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will partner directly with enterprise brands to understand their business objectives, technical ecosystems, and long-term commerce needs.
